title: Understanding the Model
text: The model shown is a polynomial regression with a logarithmic term. It includes a cubic term for the first feature and a logarithmic term for the second feature.

title: Unique Solution in OLS
text: In OLS, a unique solution exists if the design matrix X has full column rank. With $$30$$ data points and $$2$$ features, the rank condition is satisfied.

title: Effect of Ridge Regularization
text: Ridge regularization (L2) adds a penalty term to the loss function, which helps in obtaining a unique solution even if the design matrix does not have full rank.

hintAnswer: If Wesley refits the same model using L2 (Ridge) regularization with $$lambda=1$$, a unique solution will still exist.
title: Analyzing the Statements
text: Consider the effect of adding a regularization term on the uniqueness of the solution.
choices: It is highly likely, but not guaranteed, that the sum of the residuals is $$0$$.
The rank of the design matrix X must be less than $$3$$.
The vector of outcomes Y must be in the span of X.
The vector of predictions hat{Y} must be a linear combination of the outcomes Y.
If Wesley refits the same model with (x_{i1})**{6} as an additional feature, a unique solution will no longer exist.
If Wesley refits the same model using L2 (Ridge) regularization with $$lambda=1$$, a unique solution will still exist.
